text:
sophie.prodeng: Quick update for billing + product teams — were planning two related changes: 1) deprecate the automatic "auto-topup" credits feature and 2) introduce consolidated invoice delivery (one invoice per customer across orgs). Posting here for feedback and readiness checks.

billing-bot: [Draft saved] https://redwood.internal/drafts/auto-topup-deprecate (internal preview)

leo.billing: TL;DR: auto-topup (auto charge small top-up amounts when accounts run low) will be turned off for new accounts starting 2026-08-01. Existing accounts with explicit opt-in will remain until they opt out. Separately, well offer customers consolidated monthly invoices that roll up charges for linked orgs under a single billing account.

cfo.sara: Reasoning: auto-topup results in a lot of micro-charges and disputes and doesn't scale well for international tax handling. Consolidated invoices improve AR efficiency and reduce per-org invoice noise for larger customers.

engops.anya: Ops notes: turning off auto-topup reduces payment flow calls but requires a user-facing fallback (email + webhook) to notify when a payment fails or balance is low. For consolidated invoices, well add a new billing_account_id field in exports and an optional `consolidated_invoice=true` header.

support.mike: Support prep: suggested canned reply: "We've paused automatic top-ups for new accounts to reduce unexpected charges. You can opt in from Billing > Auto-topup or use the consolidated billing feature to manage multiple orgs under one invoice."

leo.billing: Action items:
- Product: add opt-in toggle and new billing settings copy; add migration path for existing opt-ins.
- Eng: export changes: CSV header will include `billing_account_id` and `consolidated_invoice` flag when applicable. Add `schema_version=5` to files that include the new fields.
- Finance: update dunning and tax handling for consolidated invoices; create mapping for linked-org GL allocations.
- Support: update dispute flow and refund guidance for micro-charge disputes.

sophie.prodeng: Important messaging note: avoid "were stopping charges" language. Use: "were changing automatic top-up defaults to give customers more control and fewer unexpected micro-charges"

billing-bot: Example CSV snippet preview:
```
schema_version=5
invoice_id,line_type,usage_units,unit_price,amount,region_code,billing_account_id,consolidated_invoice
inv_20260801,tokens,50000,0.0005,25.00,us-east,bacct_9901,true
inv_20260801,tokens,12000,0.0006,7.20,eu-west,org_1234,false
```

engops.anya: Rollout plan: internal comms now, help article + UI changes 2026-07-20, toggle available to existing customers 2026-07-27, defaults apply to new accounts 2026-08-01. Export schema migration window: 2026-07-30 02:00-02:30 UTC (exports may briefly produce mixed schema versions).

leo.billing: Finance note: consolidated invoices will show a line per org so customers can allocate costs internally; GL will still receive a single total per invoice. Expect a slight delay in AR reconciliation initially.

support.mike: Partner question: resellers and marketplaces  will they be able to opt-out of consolidated invoices?

leo.billing: Yes, reseller bills will be left unchanged by default. Marketplaces can opt into consolidation via partner settings. Well send partner-facing guidance before public rollout.

sophie.prodeng: Any blockers? If none, well publish the announcement doc tomorrow and schedule emails to accounts with existing auto-topup opt-ins.

cfo.sara: Please ensure legal sign-off on opt-in copy. Finance OK on consolidated invoices pilot.

sophie.prodeng: Thanks all — Ill post the final announcement + FAQ link here after legal review. :thumbsup:
